title: Near-repeat pair remains in separate selection families
evidence: 1318 asks for a direct Curie-law numerical scaling; 1321 asks for the same inverse-temperature law. Families are different. The constructed paper passes selection quotas and contains both; none of the 10000 fresh random runs happened to select both.
recommendation: Use a shared Curie-law selection family or an explicit mutual-exclusion rule. Retain both questions in the bank if useful; prevent their co-selection. This is an editorial near-repeat judgement, not exact textual duplication.

title: Difficulty rationales overstate the work actually needed
evidence: Six current Difficult records have validated shorter solutions that omit parts of the claimed reasoning. All six keys agree with those shorter solutions.
recommendation: Rewrite each rationale around the shortest valid solution and reassess the level. Medium is a review recommendation, not an empirical classification. If Difficult quotas are retained, strengthen the tasks or rebalance with substantive replacements.

title: Rewritten balance question still does not require its figure
status: OPEN - SUBSTANTIVE RECHECK OF A REVISED ID
evidence: For a fixed pivot, m1 dx1+m2 dx2=0. Given m1=2m2 and dx1=+1 cm, dx2=-2 cm regardless of the pictured sides. The key C is correct; figure_required=true and the explanation of dependency are not justified.
recommendation: Either mark the figure optional and align the explanation, or make an essential mass ratio, displacement or orientation available only through the figure. Recount meaningful required-figure items after the chosen repair.

title: Five malformed inverse-solution clauses
evidence: JEE27-PHY-0255: Matching the measured this maximum speed gives; JEE27-PHY-0708: Matching the measured its kinetic energy at terminal speed in the same liquid gives; JEE27-PHY-1427: Matching the measured their revolution period in the second region gives; JEE27-PHY-1840: Matching the measured its final de Broglie wavelength gives; JEE27-PHY-2153: Matching the measured its figure of merit, defined as coil current per scale division gives
recommendation: Replace with a complete grammatical phrase, e.g. "Matching the recorded value of ... gives". Synchronize applicable numerical alternates and all published exports.
